summary: Retention for date-partitioned state stores in fixos cleanup

delivery.outcome: fixos cleanup finds date-partitioned application state stores under ~/.local/state and ~/.local/share and prunes whole day partitions older than --days with a hardlink-aware reclaim estimate. JetBrains cleanup also finds data directories of superseded IDE versions that no registered install uses, and reports duplicate Toolbox installs instead of deleting them.
nonGoals: No deletion outside YYYY/MM/DD day partitions
No change to the collectors that write these stores
No automatic selection without --yes or an explicit choice

architecture.decision: Pure scanner/remover in fixos/diagnostics/state_retention.py; CLI handler in _cleanup_space.py following the thumbnails pattern; --state-old flag and -c state-old in cleanup_cmd space_actions; policy matrix entry with review risk.
interfaceChanges: fixos cleanup --jetbrains lists stale version data dirs and duplicate-install advisories
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; the option is opt-in and existing cleanup paths are unchanged.
